title: Synthesis and resolution of a 1,1′-biazulene analogue of BINOL
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14881-14892
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02520F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anthony P. Gee, Tiberiu-M. Gianga, Gabriele Kociok-Köhn, G. Dan Pantoş, Simon E. Lewis
A 1,1′-biazulenyl-2,2′-diol (“1,1′-BAzOL”) has been prepared in enantiopure form. The barrier to racemisation of this 1,1′-BAzOL has been determined and synthesis of an analogous 2,2′-bis(phosphonate) has also been achieved.
